title: Chords made from one scale
summary: Build triads using only the notes of a key, and they all fit that key.

steps.title: Diatonic chord
steps.body:
Take a note of the C major scale and stack a triad on it, using only white keys: notes from the C major scale. The result is a **diatonic chord**, a chord made only from the notes of the key. C E G, D F A and E G B are all diatonic to C major.

**Why it matters:** Most songs use mostly diatonic chords. If you know a song is in G, you already know the seven chords it is most likely to use.

steps.title: Three diatonic chords
steps.body: C, D minor and E minor: only white keys, so only notes of C major.

items.prompt: Play the triad on D using only white keys: D, F and A.
Play the triad on F using only white keys: F, A and C.
Is this chord diatonic to C major?

steps.title: Stay in the key
steps.body: Play a triad on every white key from C to B, one after another, using only white keys. Every one belongs to C major.
